These are the long-form notes for each lecture: the theory written out, with the
matching Python worked through inline so you can run and adapt it. They mirror the
[slides](../slides.qmd) and follow the [schedule](../schedule.qmd). All code uses
only `numpy`, `scipy`, `pandas`, and `matplotlib`, and simulates its own data, so
every page runs without external files.
